jobs.description:
Work Location:

Toronto, Ontario, Canada

Hours

37.5

Line Of Business

Technology Solutions

Pay Details

$170,000 - $215,000 CAD

This role is eligible for a discretionary variable compensation award that considers business and individual performance.

TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.

As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.

Job Description

The Head, Technology Portfolio Management, Transaction Banking is the accountable executive for the integrated management and delivery oversight of the full Transaction Banking technology portfolio spanning digital channels, ledger and payments. The role converts business and technology strategy into a prioritized, funded and executable portfolio; oversees multiple concurrent programs and projects, including Tier 1 initiatives; and provides a single, trusted view of portfolio health, value, risk, dependencies and decisions to senior executives.

The role leads a significant, high-complexity, multi-year portfolio with substantial regulatory and risk oversight; manages aggregate portfolio financials, including budget, forecast, actuals and variances, and benefits realization; operates portfolio governance and controls; and leads senior program and project management talent. The current portfolio scale is approximately $235 million for 2026, with a similar level anticipated for 2027, subject to annual planning and approval.

VCP technology portfolio across Transaction Banking digital channels, client connectivity and servicing capabilities; modern ledger and ledger integration; and wholesale payments platforms and rails.
Multiple concurrent, interdependent transformation programs and technology initiatives, including high-complexity and Tier 1 work, with material enterprise dependencies.
Accountability for integrated portfolio planning, prioritization, financial management, delivery governance, risk and control oversight, benefits realization, executive reporting and talent leadership.
Portfolio headcount, vendor spend, geographic mandate and committee memberships are to be confirmed through role evaluation and annual planning; the 2026 technology portfolio budget is approximately $235 million, with a similar scale anticipated for 2027.
Portfolio strategy and prioritization
Define and maintain the integrated Transaction Banking technology strategy, investment thesis and multi-year roadmap across digital channels, ledger and payments, translating business strategy into executable technology priorities in partnership with Product, Operations and Architecture.
Translate business priorities, architecture visions, regulatory obligations and platform health needs into a sequenced portfolio with clear outcomes, dependencies and funding requirements.
Recommend portfolio investment, sequencing, capacity and scope trade-offs; stop, defer or redirect work where value, readiness, risk or strategic alignment is insufficient.
Ensure the portfolio balances transformation, modernization, resilience, regulatory and mandatory commitments, and sustainable run-state outcomes.
Integrated delivery and dependency management
Oversee end-to-end delivery performance across all in-scope, multi-year programs and projects and multiple agile teams, with accountability for coherent execution against approved scope, milestones, budget, quality and benefits.
Own the integrated portfolio plan, critical path and cross-domain dependency view, resolving conflicts across channels, ledger, payments and shared enterprise platforms.
Establish clear intervention and escalation mechanisms; identify emerging slippage early and drive timely corrective action and executive decisions.
Ensure disciplined transition from design and build through testing, implementation, stabilization and hand-off to accountable run-state owners.
Financial, capacity and benefits management
Own aggregate portfolio financial management, including annual planning, forecasts, actuals, variances, vendor commitments and investment transparency.
Align funding and capacity to the highest-value and highest-obligation priorities, while maintaining traceability from investment to deliverables, outcomes and benefits.
Establish benefits baselines and oversee realization of client, financial, operational, resilience and risk outcomes; address benefit leakage and underperformance.
Optimize the deployment of senior program, project and specialized resources across the portfolio.
Governance, risk and control
Operate portfolio governance as a decision system, with clear accountabilities, decision rights, escalation thresholds, KPIs, executive reporting and disciplined follow-through.
Maintain an integrated view of delivery, technology, operational, cyber, data, regulatory, third-party and change risks, including assumptions and dependencies.
Ensure risk and control requirements are embedded from design through implementation and that portfolio evidence supports audit, regulatory and governance expectations.
Provide strategic guidance to business and functional leaders on material portfolio issues and ensure concerns are managed within enterprise risk appetite.
Executive leadership and talent
Provide a single, credible executive narrative on portfolio status, value, financials, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
Lead and develop senior program managers, project managers and portfolio specialists; build succession, capability and disciplined performance management across the function.
Create a culture of accountability, transparency, constructive challenge, inclusion and continuous improvement.
Act as the senior portfolio management advisor to Transaction Banking Product, Technology, Operations, Architecture, Finance, Risk and Compliance leaders.

Skills, Education & Experience

15+ years of progressive experience in financial-services technology, portfolio, program or transformation leadership, including significant executive-level accountability in a complex regulated institution.
Demonstrated success overseeing a significant portfolio of multiple concurrent, high-complexity programs and projects, including Tier 1 initiatives and substantial technology investment.
Deep knowledge of Transaction Banking technology domains, including corporate digital channels and connectivity, payments and cash-management infrastructure, liquidity solutions, ledger or core-banking integration, APIs, data, cloud platforms and platform modernization.
Proven experience with portfolio financial management, integrated planning, benefits realization, vendor oversight, delivery governance and executive reporting.
Experience leading senior program and project management teams and influencing large matrixed delivery organizations across business, technology and control functions.
Demonstrated delivery in environments with material regulatory, cyber, operational resilience, data and third-party risk requirements.

Leadership and technical skills

Enterprise portfolio strategy, prioritization and investment governance.
Executive judgment, commercial acumen and value-based decision making.
Integrated roadmap, dependency, critical-path and risk management.
Technology fluency across architecture, engineering, cloud, APIs, data, cybersecurity, resilience and platform operating models.
Outstanding executive communication, board-level storytelling and ability to present a concise, evidence-based view of decisions and trade-offs.
Strong stakeholder influence, conflict resolution and ability to lead through ambiguity without relying solely on direct authority.
People leadership, talent development, succession planning and creation of high-performing, inclusive teams.

Education and credentials

Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, Finance or a related discipline.
MBA, advanced technical degree or equivalent executive experience preferred.
Portfolio, program, project, Agile, Lean or technology governance certifications are assets, such as PfMP, PgMP, PMP, SAFe or equivalent.

Who We Are

TD Securities offers a wide range of capital markets products and services to corporate, government, and institutional clients who choose us for our innovation, execution, and experience. With more than 6,500 professionals operating out of 40 cities across the globe, we strive to make every interaction, product and experience remarkably human and refreshingly simple. Our services include underwriting and distributing new issues, providing trusted advice and industry-leading insight, extending access to global markets, and delivering integrated transaction banking solutions. In 2023, we acquired Cowen Inc., offering our clients access to a premier U.S. equities business and highly-diverse equity research franchise, while growing our strong, diversified investment bank.

Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards Package

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical, and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes a base salary, variable compensation, and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off, banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition programs. Learn more

Additional Information

We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Please be advised that this job opportunity is subject to provincial regulation for employment purposes. It is imperative to acknowledge that each province or territory within the jurisdiction of Canada may have its own set of regulations, requirements.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

Training & Onboarding

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.

Interview Process

We’ll reach out to candidates of interest to schedule an interview. We do our best to communicate outcomes to all applicants by email or phone call.

Accommodation

Your accessibility is important to us. Please let us know if you’d like accommodations (including accessible meeting rooms, captioning for virtual interviews, etc.) to help us remove barriers so that you can participate throughout the interview process.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:

Type:

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.
